browser_harness_attempts.correction: Granted only the already-authorized private-context sanitized text-write permission; actual clipboard/read/hash passed; context removed.

browser_harness_attempts.failure: An unfiltered stale ResourceTiming entry was compared to a filtered UI, and a transient row was read while a filter fetch changed.
browser_harness_attempts.correction: Cleared the timing buffer, correlated the completed filtered request, and inspected settled rows; server and UI IDs matched. No product filter defect was inferred.

browser_harness_attempts.failure: Concurrent waitForDownload/click hit the tab serialization guard; the unhandled waiter rejection restarted the JS worker.
browser_harness_attempts.correction: Recovered owned handles/durable server records; serialized click and collected actual completed download records/files. No mock or clipboard shim is byte proof.

browser_harness_attempts.failure: Managed private-target adoption is unsupported and a separate owned Edge artifact-profile launch timed out.
browser_harness_attempts.correction: Used authorized raw Puppeteer for the private context; kept the registered managed tab for actual file retrieval. No browser security flag was disabled.

non_CI_formatter_attempt.failure: A root-default Ruff check was used without the repository explicit configuration and was not a valid CI result.
non_CI_formatter_attempt.correction: Used the exact CI --config; only the new probe required formatting. Original executed bytes and equal normalized AST are bound in format-binding.json.

limits: These are prerequisite/harness failures, not silently discarded product passes. The successful receipts identify exactly what was later exercised.
